protocolTasks.title: Create account
protocolTasks.description: Sign up for a trial or sandbox account. Record plan, signup friction, and verification steps.

protocolTasks.title: Complete onboarding
protocolTasks.description: Finish the product onboarding / setup wizard. Note forced steps, skips, and clarity.

protocolTasks.title: Import sample contacts
protocolTasks.description: Import a small CSV or sample contact set. Record mapping UX and errors.

protocolTasks.title: Create company
protocolTasks.description: Create an organization/company record and link a contact.

protocolTasks.title: Create pipeline
protocolTasks.description: Create or customize a sales pipeline with stages.

protocolTasks.title: Create deal
protocolTasks.description: Create a deal/opportunity on the pipeline.

protocolTasks.title: Move deal through pipeline
protocolTasks.description: Advance the deal across stages (drag-and-drop or stage change).

protocolTasks.title: Configure automation
protocolTasks.description: Create a simple workflow/automation (e.g. stage change → activity).

protocolTasks.title: Create report / dashboard
protocolTasks.description: Build or open a report/dashboard relevant to pipeline activity. Stretch for 45–60m sessions — mark BLOCKED/NOT_AVAILABLE if timeboxed.

protocolTasks.title: Test email / integration
protocolTasks.description: Connect or exercise email sync / a core integration if the plan allows. Stretch — use NOT_AVAILABLE/BLOCKED when gated or out of time.

protocolTasks.title: Test search
protocolTasks.description: Search for contacts, companies, and deals; note relevance and speed. Stretch for express sessions.

protocolTasks.title: Test permissions
protocolTasks.description: If available on the plan, verify role/permission controls for a second user or visibility setting.

protocolTasks.title: Test mobile / responsiveness
protocolTasks.description: Open the web app on a narrow viewport or mobile app if available; note usable vs broken flows.

protocolTasks.title: Inspect admin / configuration
protocolTasks.description: Review admin settings: custom fields, pipelines, users, billing entry points.

protocolTasks.title: Inspect help / support
protocolTasks.description: Open in-app help, docs, chat, or ticket paths. Record channel quality — do not invent response times you did not experience.

protocolTasks.title: Record setup friction
protocolTasks.description: Summarize time-to-value, confusing steps, and blockers from account creation through first useful pipeline view.

protocolTasks.title: Verify pricing
protocolTasks.description: Compare in-app / billing plan labels to the public pricing page. Record plan tested and list prices observed.

protocolTasks.description: Finish setup wizard (domain/brand/list). Note forced vs optional steps.

protocolTasks.title: Import or create a list
protocolTasks.description: Create a list/audience and import a small CSV or add contacts manually.

protocolTasks.title: Inspect contact profile
protocolTasks.description: Open a contact record; note fields, tags, activity timeline, and edit UX.

protocolTasks.title: Create campaign draft
protocolTasks.description: Build a draft email/campaign (subject, body, audience). Do not send to real customers.

protocolTasks.title: Test email editor
protocolTasks.description: Exercise drag-and-drop or code editor; note templates, mobile preview, and limitations.

protocolTasks.title: Configure automation
protocolTasks.description: Create a simple automation (e.g. tag added → send email / wait).

protocolTasks.title: Test form / landing page
protocolTasks.description: Create or open a signup form or landing page builder if available on the plan. Stretch for 45–60m sessions.

protocolTasks.title: Inspect analytics / reporting
protocolTasks.description: Open campaign or automation reports (opens, clicks, bounce). Note clarity of metrics.

protocolTasks.title: Test integration catalog
protocolTasks.description: Open integrations directory; attempt or inspect a CRM/ecommerce connection if plan allows. Stretch — use BLOCKED/NOT_AVAILABLE when gated.

protocolTasks.title: Inspect deliverability settings
protocolTasks.description: Find domain authentication (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), sending domains, or reputation tips. Stretch for express sessions.

protocolTasks.title: Test search
protocolTasks.description: Search contacts, campaigns, and automations; note speed and relevance. Stretch for express sessions.

protocolTasks.title: Test permissions / team
protocolTasks.description: If available, review user roles or invite a second seat; else mark NOT_AVAILABLE.

protocolTasks.title: Test mobile / responsiveness
protocolTasks.description: Narrow viewport or mobile app; note usable vs broken flows.

protocolTasks.title: Inspect help / support
protocolTasks.description: Open help center, chat, or ticket paths. Only record channels you actually opened.

protocolTasks.title: Record setup friction
protocolTasks.description: Summarize time-to-first-useful draft, confusing steps, and blockers.

protocolTasks.title: Verify pricing
protocolTasks.description: Compare in-app / billing plan labels to the public pricing page. Record plan tested.
